title: Austin: Fire & Police Hires, Fines Waived
summary:
*   **Public Safety Personnel:** Approved new hosemen for the fire department and a new patrolman for the police force, while also dismissing an existing fire department hoseman.
*   **Sewer Connection Extension:** Granted a resident until January 1918 to complete their required sewer connection.
*   **Legal Relief:** Remitted fines and dismissed cases for two individuals, including one related to an intoxication charge.

Regular meeting of the City Council : Austin, Texas. Sept 5th 1917: The Council was called
to order by the Mayor: Roll called: Present Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony,
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Absent none: The minutes of the last regular and subsequent
recessed meetings were read and adopted:
Reports of City Officers:
The Mayor laid before the Council the reports e the Assessor & Collector, the Sexton, the
Public Weigher, the Inspector of Weights and Measures, the City Engineer & the Plumbing
Inspector, which were read and filed:

Councilman Anthony nominated Grover Griffin and A B enham to be Hosemen, which nominations
were confirmed by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Bartholomew,
Haynes & Powell 4
Not voting Councilman Anthony 1
Walter Hearn On motion of Councilman Anthony, the Chief of the Fire Dept was directed to
services dispensed notify Walter Hearn, that his services as hoseman in the Fire Dept
would not with be needed after October 1 st 1917; The motion was adopted by the following
vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none:

Sept 7th 1917: All present :
Councilman Anthony nominated Geo S Bailey to be Patrolman, which nomination was confirmed
by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4
Not voting Councilman Anthony 1.
Sept 10th 1917: All present :
L. Leatherman The Mayor laid before the Council a petition from L Leatherman, in regard to
Time extended sewer connection, which was read and on motion time was granted him until
Sewer Connection January 1st 1918, in which to make connection, by the following vote:
Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none:

D.J. Fallon Application of D J Fallon for license as driver of service car was presented
Driver License and license granted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge,
Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none: Councilman Anthony offered
the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas :
Clara Brown That upon recommendation of the prosecuting Attorney, Mr. A.S Phelps, fine
remitted the case against Clara Brown in the Corporation Court of the City of Austin,
Texas, No 13201 be and the same is hereby ordered dismissed.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilman
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
